t: An Oirat Mongol khanate founded in the 1630s in Dzungaria and the Ili valley under the Choros dynasty.
It conquered the Tarim Basin, sacked Lhasa in 1717 and devastated the Kazakh steppe, contesting Central Asia with the Qing.
After succession wars, Qing armies destroyed it in 1755–1758 in a campaign many historians call a genocide.
dyk: The Dzungars cast cannon with the help of Johan Gustaf Renat, a Swedish officer captured by Russia at Poltava in 1709 who later fell into Dzungar hands.
ev: Erdeni Batur joins the assembly that drafts the Mongol-Oirat Code
Galdan conquers the Yarkent Khanate and the Tarim Basin oases
Kangxi's armies defeat Galdan at the Battle of Jao Modo
Dzungar forces under Tsering Dondub sack Lhasa
Dzungar invasion of the Kazakh steppe begins the 'Great Disaster'
Galdan Tseren destroys a Qing army at Hoton Nor
Qing armies reach the Ili valley; Amursana rebels
Qing troops and smallpox destroy most of the Dzungar population

f.capital: Khobuk River settlement; later the Ili valley (near modern Ghulja)
